name: flexible-places
description: Ask ChatGPT about your Flexible Places activity as a host: what needs your attention, reservations, bids, invoices, documents, workflows, occupancy and revenue.

interface.longDescription:
Flexible Places is a platform for renting commercial spaces, stands and promotional locations. This plugin lets a host or administrator ask ChatGPT about their own activity, in plain language, using read-only tools.

What you can ask:
- What needs my action today: pending approvals, the oldest unanswered requests, payments that failed or are in dispute, documents waiting to be sent or signed, and check-ins and check-outs in the next 14 days.
- How my spaces are doing: occupancy, locations with no bookings, revenue against budget and answer times.
- Look up and follow records: find reservations, orders, brands (also by activity), circuits, spaces, locations and biddings by name; read the history of a reservation, an order or a bidding; see open requests, invoice status, documents to follow up and the workflow status of a reservation.
- Which brands booked in a period (by stay dates, by default the last 6 months) and what activity they have: reservations, locations, first and last stay and a count per activity. No amounts.
- Which account and workspace I am connected to.

Every answer links back to the matching screen of the platform, where you decide and act.

What it does not do: it never creates, changes, approves, pays or deletes anything. All its tools are read-only, and ChatGPT only sees what your own role and workspace already allow you to see in Flexible Places. It does not use or expose any other customer's data.

You sign in with your own Flexible Places account and can revoke the connection at any time from your profile (Connected assistants). Your account must have the AI assistant feature enabled for your workspace.
capabilities: Brands that booked and their activity

Which payments failed or are in dispute?
How is occupancy in the last 30 days, and how is revenue against budget?

positive.description: Daily digest of what needs action
positive.prompt: What needs my attention today in Flexible Places?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short list of what needs action today for the demo company (pending approvals, unanswered requests, payments, documents, upcoming events) with a link to the matching screen for each item. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Which brands booked, and their activity
positive.prompt: Which brands booked in the last 6 months, and what activity do they have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the brands of the demo company with a stay in the last 6 months (the period is stated in the answer), each with its activity, number of reservations, locations and first and last stay, plus a count of brands per activity. It shows no amounts and does not change anything.

positive.prompt: Find the spaces called Demo Studio and show their locations.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the spaces of the demo company whose name matches, with a link to each one. It does not change anything.

positive.prompt: Which payments failed or are in dispute?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the payments of the demo company that failed or are in dispute, with amounts and links. It does not collect, refund or modify any payment.

positive.prompt: How is occupancy in the last 30 days, and how is revenue against budget?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports occupancy per location (Demo Studio A and Demo Studio B) for the last 30 days and revenue against budget, stating the period used.

negative.description: Approving a request is not supported
negative.prompt: Approve the pending reservation request from the demo company.

negative.description: Paying or refunding is not supported
negative.prompt: Refund the payment that failed and charge the customer again.

negative.description: Data of other customers is not available
negative.prompt: Show me the reservations of another company that uses Flexible Places.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads the host's own activity.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.3.0: three new read-only tools, twenty-nine in total. New for hosts and administrators: which brands booked in a period (by stay dates, by default the last 6 months), with their activity, reservations, locations and a count per activity, with no amounts; brand search also shows and filters by activity. Two more tools are only for a superadministrator. Nothing was removed or renamed, and every tool stays read-only.
